frontend.reason: event.available_tickets is undefined on event detail page because API returns ticket_count

rca_of_the_issue: ScarcityBadge not displaying: Root cause is field name mismatch between events list API (returns 'available_tickets') and single event detail API (returns 'ticket_count'). EventDetailsPage.jsx line 406 passes event.available_tickets to ScarcityBadge, which is undefined for single event data. Fix: Either update /api/events/{slug} to include available_tickets field, or change line 406 to use event.ticket_count || event.available_tickets.
